title: Cloning with NEB Instant Sticky-end Ligase Master Mix (M0370)
author: Harold Bien

steps.title: Prepare ligase master mix on ice
steps.instruction: Place the NEB Instant Sticky‑end Ligase Master Mix tube (Catalog #M0370S, 50 reactions) on ice and flick the tube a few times to mix.

steps.title: Set up vector‑insert ligation
steps.instruction: Combine 20–100 ng of vector with a 3‑fold molar excess of insert, then add nuclease‑free water to a final volume of 5 µl.

steps.title: Add master mix and chill
steps.instruction: Add 5 µl of the Instant Sticky‑end Ligase Master Mix to the 5 µl ligation mixture, pipette up and down 7–10 times to mix thoroughly, and place the reaction on ice. The ligation is now ready for transformation.

steps.title: Add competent cells and ligation
steps.instruction: Prepare the transformation mixture by adding the ligation to competent cells.

substeps.instruction: Aliquot 50 µl of competent cells into a 1.5 ml microcentrifuge tube.
Add 2 µl of the ligation reaction to the cells.
Mix by gentle finger‑flicking; do not vortex.

steps.title: Incubate on ice
steps.instruction: Incubate the tube on ice for 30 minutes without mixing.

steps.title: Heat‑shock transformation
steps.instruction: Heat‑shock the tube at 42 °C for 30 seconds.

steps.title: Add recovery media
steps.instruction: Add 950 µl of recovery medium (e.g., SOC) to the tube.

steps.title: Recover cells at 37 °C
steps.instruction: Incubate the mixture for 1 hour at 37 °C with rotation or shaking at 200–250 rpm.

steps.title: Plate outgrowth and incubate
steps.instruction: Spread 100 µl of the outgrowth (undiluted or diluted 1:5 with recovery media) onto appropriate antibiotic selection plates and incubate overnight at 37 °C.
